name: Hybrid Retrieval, RRF Fusion & MMR Reranker Engine

dynamicAdaptiveWeighting.codeIdentifierDensity: rho_code in [0, 1] with Unicode punctuation stripping and all-caps query protection

specCompliance.scoreFusion: MinMax Convex Score Fusion with zero-anchor real amplitude preservation across HYBRID, SPARSE, and DENSE modes

mmrReranker.formula: MMR = argmax_{d_i in R \ S} [ lambda * Sim_1(d_i, q) - (1 - lambda) * max_{d_j in S} Sim_2(d_i, d_j) ]
mmrReranker.selectionMethod: Sequential Greedy Selection with O(K * N) cached token sets and topN <= 0 boundary guard
mmrReranker.calibration: Sigmoid Logit Calibration sigma(z / T) with NaN protection

specCompliance.deduplication: Exact ID and normalized whitespace content-level deduplication without arbitrary length thresholds
